source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Απριλίου — «Άγιοι Εβδομήκοντα Στρατιώτες»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **The page enumerates nobody**, so this is one entry and not seventy folders: the whole body is «Οι Άγιοι Εβδομήκοντα Στρατιώτες πίστεψαν στον Χριστό δια του Άγιου Σάββα και μαρτύρησαν δια ξίφους» — the seventy soldiers believed in Christ through Sabbas and were martyred by the sword. The Sabbas meant is Sabbas Stratelates the Goth, whose own page on this day tells the occasion: when the martyr was thrown into a boiling cauldron of pitch and came out unharmed, seventy of the idolaters standing there believed and were beheaded on the spot. Sabbas's page dates his own death to 272 and theirs is the same occasion, but this page gives them no year of their own, so no `dates` were taken. It names no captain, no city and no judge, and prints no hymn and no relic.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 07.05.2026 (24. април ст. ст.) — „Св. муч. Сава Стратилат.“

attestations.note: The Prologue's heading for this entry names the commander alone, „Св. муч. Сава Стратилат.“, and the body counts the company that followed him: „Њих 70 на броју одмах бише по наредби царевој посечени.“ So this row rests on the body and not on the heading, which does not mention them; the quoted line is the heading whole, as BRIEF-SERBIAN.md §4 requires. **The entry gives the company no names at all, only a number**, so this folder gains no `sr` name form from it: a number is not a name, and the corpus's English display name is a count too.
